arxiv-1805-09618.title: AXION MASS IN THE CASE OF POST-INFLATIONARY PECCEI-QUINN SYMMETRY BREAKING
arxiv-1805-09618.creator: A. RINGWALD
arxiv-1805-09618.description: Abstract The axion not only solves the strong C ​ P CP puzzle, but it also may be the main constituent of cold dark matter. We review the axion dark matter predictions for the case that the Peccei-Quinn symmetry is restored after inflation.

arxiv-2011-10364.title: Towards Abstract Relational Learning in Human Robot Interaction
arxiv-2011-10364.creator: Mohamadreza Faridghasemnia, Daniele Nardi, Alessandro Saffiotti
arxiv-2011-10364.description: Abstract Humans have a rich representation of the entities in their environment. Entities are described by their attributes, and entities that share attributes are often semantically related. For example, if two books have “Natural Language Processing” as value of their ‘title’ attribute, we can expect that their ‘topic’ attribute will also be equal, namely, “NLP”.

arxiv-2305-01915.description: Abstract . There is a rapidly-growing research interest in engaging users with multi-modal data for accurate user modeling on recommender systems. Existing multimedia recommenders have achieved substantial improvements by incorporating various modalities and devising delicate modules. However, when users decide to interact with items, most of them do not fully read the content of all modalities.

arxiv-2401-02445.title: Social and Economic Impact Analysis of Solar Mini-Grids in Rural Africa: A Cohort Study from Kenya and Nigeria Journal: Environmental Research: Infrastructure and Sustainability
arxiv-2401-02445.creator: A.T. Carabajal, A. Orsot, M.P.E. Moudio, T. Haggai, C.J. Okonkwo, G.T. Jarrard III, N.S. Selby
arxiv-2401-02445.description: Abstract This study presents the first comprehensive analysis of the social and economic effects of solar mini-grids in rural African settings, specifically in Kenya and Nigeria. A group of 2,658 household heads and business owners connected to mini-grids over the last five years were interviewed both before and one year after their connection.

arxiv-2402-02028.title: Unlearnable Examples For Time Series
arxiv-2402-02028.creator: Yujing Jiang, Xingjun Ma, Sarah Monazam Erfani, James Bailey
arxiv-2402-02028.description: Abstract Unlearnable examples (UEs) refer to training samples modified to be unlearnable to Deep Neural Networks (DNNs). These examples are usually generated by adding error-minimizing noises that can fool a DNN model into believing that there is nothing (no error) to learn from the data.

arxiv-2411-18085.description: Abstract . The value assessment of private properties is an attractive but challenging task which is widely concerned by a majority of people around the world. A prolonged topic among us is “ how much is my house worth? ”.

arxiv-2502-05789.title: Finite Volume Hamiltonian method for two-particle systems containing long-range potential on the lattice
arxiv-2502-05789.creator: Kang Yu, Guang-Juan Wang, Jia-Jun Wu, Zhi Yang
arxiv-2502-05789.description: Abstract We propose a systematic method to block-diagonalize the finite volume effective Hamiltonian for two-particle systems with arbitrary spin in both the rest and moving frame. The framework is convenient and efficient for addressing the left-hand cut issue arising from long-range potential, which are challenging in the framework of standard Lüscher formula.

arxiv-2601-18017.title: Beyond secondary instability: on the emergence of finite-amplitude waves in Görtler vortices
arxiv-2601-18017.creator: Runjie Song 1, Kengo Deguchi 1
arxiv-2601-18017.description: Abstract Görtler vortices developing over a concave wall support rapidly oscillating wavelike disturbances through secondary instabilities. Although experiments indicate that the finite-amplitude evolution of these waves acts as a precursor to turbulence transition, accurate and efficient prediction has remained out of reach.

arxiv-2602-24101.title: Bayesian Inference of Flame Impulse Responses
arxiv-2602-24101.creator: Matthew Yoko, Wolfgang Polifke
arxiv-2602-24101.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Matthew Yoko, Wolfgang Polifke. The impulse response of a flame to acoustic velocity perturbations is a key quantity for predicting thermoacoustic stability, but its identification from sparse, noisy observations requires solving an ill-posed inverse convolution problem. This is typically achieved with system identification methods, which require hand-tuning of regularization, model order, and sampling parameters, and provide no principled mechanism for incorporating prior physical knowledge. In this paper, we reformulate the identification problem within a Bayesian framework.

pmc-10541745.title: 10 years of biologic use patterns in patients with inflammatory bowel disease: treatment persistence, switching and dose intensification – a nationwide population-based study
pmc-10541745.creator: Hee Moon Koo, Yu Kyung Jun, Yonghoon Choi, Cheol Min Shin, Young Soo Park, Nayoung Kim, Dong Ho Lee, Young Kee Shin, Hyuk Yoon
pmc-10541745.description: Background:Treatments for inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) have evolved in the era of biologics. However, the real-world data on their usage patterns and sequencing are still limited.Objectives:We aimed to investigate treatment persistence and dose intensification of first- and second-line biologics in patients with IBD.

pmc-11453230.title: 8697 Effects of Fibrate Combination Therapy on the Prevention and Progression of Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease in Patients with Dyslipidemia Undergoing Statin Treatment: A Retrospective Cohort Study Using Dada from the Korean National Health Insurance Service
pmc-11453230.creator: Jong Han Choi, Suk Kyeong Kim, Dong-Lim Lim, Kee-Ho Song
pmc-11453230.description: Disclosure: J. Choi: None. S. Kim: None. D. Lim: None. K. Song: None. Background and Hypothesis: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), recognized as part of the metabolic syndrome, has become a significant public health issue. However, there has been no suitable pharmacological treatment beyond lifestyle management due to the lack of appropriate modalities for early diagnosis and treatment response assessment.

pmc-11483419.title: Prognostic value of PLEKHA4 and its correlation with tumor-infiltrating immune cells in breast cancer: a comprehensive study based on bioinformatics and clinical analysis validation
pmc-11483419.creator: Liu Li, Zewen Feng, Ye Zhao, Boan Lai, Qingxin Zhang, Zhongtang Xiong, Wei Zhang
pmc-11483419.description: BackgroundPleckstrin homology containing family A, number 4 (PLEKHA4) plays a role in a number of biological processes in human cells, including cell polarization, growth, and proliferation. However, the relationship between PLEKHA4 expression and survival in breast cancer (BC) remains unclear. The aim of this study is to investigate the potential of PLEKHA4 as a prognostic indicator in BC.

pmc-11593372.title: Ultrasound Irradiation as a Candidate Procedure to Improve the Transdermal Drug Delivery to the Tail Edema of a Mouse Model
pmc-11593372.creator: Shinji Kumegawa, Takuya Suzuki, Kota Fujimoto, Kazuhisa Uemura, Katsuro Tachibana, Gen Yamada, Shinichi Asamura, Laura Patton
pmc-11593372.description: Drug therapy for secondary lymphedema has not yet been established. Conventional oral and intravenous administration is difficult to administer in sufficient doses due to adverse events. Therefore, it is necessary to develop a transdermal delivery system that can deliver high concentrations of drugs to the edema area.

pmc-11606609.title: Menopause and Quality of Life Among Greek Women in Rural Areas
pmc-11606609.creator: Giannoula A Kyrkou, Eleni Karozi, Anastasia Bothou, Anna Deltsidou, Athina Diamanti, Nikoleta Tsinisizeli, Aikaterini Lykeridou, Antigoni Sarantaki
pmc-11606609.description: IntroductionThe World Health Organization defines menopause as the permanent termination of ovarian function and the absence of menstruation for a minimum of 12 months. A woman's quality of life and health may be affected by menopause, a physiological condition that is typically accompanied by vasomotor, physical, and psychological disorders.

pmc-11640441.title: Epichaperome Inhibition by PU-H71-Mediated Targeting of HSP90 Sensitizes Glioblastoma Cells to Alkylator-Induced DNA Damage
pmc-11640441.creator: Pratibha Sharma, Jihong Xu, Vinay K Puduvalli, Mikael S Lindström
pmc-11640441.description: Simple SummaryGliomas are malignant primary brain tumors recognized for acquiring resistance to conventional chemotherapy and radiotherapy. These tumors’ genetic heterogeneity and altered epigenetics contribute to their poor prognosis, underscoring the need to develop therapeutic strategies that target multiple pathways required for glioma cell survival and proliferation.

pmc-12470339.title: Association of Pan-Immune-Inflammation Value with All-Cause and Cardiovascular Mortality in Survivors of Myocardial Infarction: NHANES 2001–2018 Analysis
pmc-12470339.creator: Qingyi Liu, Wenling Yang, Ruiyu Zhang, Xiaopeng Guo, Yumiao Wei
pmc-12470339.description: Background: Inflammatory responses critically impact long-term outcomes in myocardial infarction (MI) survivors, yet few biomarkers comprehensively evaluate systemic immune-inflammatory status. This study assessed the prognostic utility of a novel marker—the pan-immune-inflammation value (PIV)—for predicting all-cause and cardiovascular mortality post-MI. Methods: Using the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data (2001–2018), 1559 MI survivors were included.

pmc-12644723.title: The interaction and mediation role of intrinsic capacity in the association between asthma and all-cause mortality
pmc-12644723.creator: Yangyang Cheng, Yue Zhang, Junjie Lin, Chenjie Xu, Xiaolin Xu
pmc-12644723.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Asthma and intrinsic capacity (IC) decline were individually examined with mortality, yet the complex interplay between them remains largely unknown. This study aimed to examine the potential roles of IC decline in the association between asthma and all-cause mortality. We conducted a prospective cohort study using data from UK Biobank, where IC decline was defined as a decline in any domain of psychological, sensory, vitality, and locomotion.

pmc-13266168.title: Pre-operative glenoid bone density varies by indication for reverse shoulder arthroplasty: a comparison of glenoid bone density in proximal humerus fractures, glenohumeral osteoarthritis, and rotator cuff arthropathy
pmc-13266168.creator: Alec M Reihl, Blake E Bohlig, Nicholas Wiley, Mark Cote, Evan A O'Donnell
pmc-13266168.description: BackgroundGlenoid bone mineral density (BMD) has important implications for the fixation of glenoid components and may vary based on indications for reverse total shoulder arthroplasty (rTSA).17 Careful consideration of pre-operative bone quality can enable surgeons to improve pre-operative and intraoperative decision-making for glenoid component fixation and reduce associated complications, such as aseptic loosening.

pmc-13301964.title: A machine learning based approach on the value of 12-lead ecg to predict success of catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation
pmc-13301964.creator: S Knecht, N Gruetter, F Waldmann, I Strebel, D Spreen, P Badertscher, P Krisai, N Schaerli, V Schlageter, A Luca, T Kueffer, J Boeddinghaus, F Mahfoud, M Kuehne, C Sticherling
pmc-13301964.description: BackgroundThe standard 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) offers a universally available and cost-effective method for assessing and quantifying individual electrical characteristics of the left atrium in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF).PurposeTo evaluate the prognostic value of pre-procedural 12-lead ECGs for predicting atrial fibrillation (AF) recurrence after catheter ablation (CA).

pmc-13331383.title: Primary Hepatic Histiocytic Sarcoma Mimicking Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-13331383.creator: Evgenia Tziava, Aikaterini Leventi, Maria Arnaouti, Nektarios Ntalakos, Maria Igoumenidi, Dimitris P. Korkolis
pmc-13331383.description: Primary hepatic histiocytic sarcoma (HS) is an exceptionally rare malignancy with nonspecific clinical and morphological features that often mimic other high-grade liver tumors making their diagnosis challenging. We report a 74-year-old man presenting with abdominal and back pain, fatigue, and a solitary right-lobe hepatic mass. Imaging suggested hepatocellular carcinoma, and the patient underwent right posterior sectionectomy.

pmc-13547384.title: Exploration and practice of home care mode for elderly with stroke disability based on ICF theory
pmc-13547384.creator: Chen Zhi, Zhou Chunna, Chen Yuanyuan, Zheng Chunxi, Han Saiyue, He Ningning, Hong Bo, Cao Minfei
pmc-13547384.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Most existing studies on family care for older adults with stroke-related disability focus mainly on caregiving skills training, with limited integration of patients’ functional status and rehabilitation needs into health promotion services. A total of 104 mildly to moderately disabled older adults with stroke and their primary caregivers were recruited from one medical and health care group between September 2023 and October 2024.

pmc-13558726.title: Machine learning reveals structural determinants of odor detection thresholds and identifies high-potency food odorants
pmc-13558726.creator: Xin Hou, Zhilei Zhou, Peiqin Shi, Yan Wang, Shuangping Liu, Zhongwei Ji, Dachuan Zhang, Jian Mao
pmc-13558726.description: Odor detection threshold (ODT) quantifies the perceptual potency of volatile compounds and is a key parameter in flavor chemistry. It is widely used to identify key food odorants, calculate odor activity values, and evaluate the contribution of volatiles to overall aroma perception.

pmc-13589320.title: Mediastinal tracheostomy: techniques, outcomes and quality of life—a systematic review
pmc-13589320.creator: Jonas Peter Ehrsam, Ana-Maria Petrone, Marko Aleksic, Paul Christian Fuchs, Steffen Maune, Theresa Stork, Stéphane Collaud
pmc-13589320.description: BackgroundMediastinal tracheostomy (MT) is a rare, technically demanding salvage procedure in which the distal trachea is redirected into the upper mediastinum. It is indicated when extensive resection of the proximal trachea precludes conventional tracheal reconstruction or cervical tracheostomy. It is performed for a variety of underlying diseases.

uslaw-usc-t46-s5101.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s5101.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Part C (Load Lines Of Vessels); Chapter 51 (Load Lines). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter— (1) “domestic voyage” means movement of a vessel between places in, or subject to the jurisdiction of, the United States, except movement between— (A) a place in a territory or possession of the United States or the Trust.
